change: Precache all four new family photos and include their content revisions in the family worker namespace.

checks.npm run verify:security: PASS: 353 security checks and catalog revision contract

negative_control.result: Expected FAIL: all four family photos absent from CacheStorage before the first panel reveal.

positive_control: Fresh Chromium context installs the worker without opening the family panel. All four URLs are present in CacheStorage before offline mode. First reveal renders three recipes and the non-orderable Kids Box, and all four 900x900 images decode.
limitations: Playwright context offline mode does not block service-worker network fetches in this environment. The explicit pre-reveal CacheStorage assertion supplies the precache regression proof.
This release introduces new image paths; it does not test future replacement of image bytes under an HTTP cache entry.
Existing visual evidence in evidence.json is historical for the parent tree; the UI, CSS, HTML and image bytes are unchanged by this follow-up.
